entries.source: Drag a line, then drag twice to set its two bends. Finish curve commits it early.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo para ticchihuaz ce tlahuazantli; teipan oc xictotoxo ome huelta para xicchihua ome huihcoltic. Ica “Xictlamilti ni tlahuazantli huihcoltic” hueli tictlamiltia achtohui.

entries.source: Drag a selection. Drag inside to move, square corner or edge handles to resize, or the round handle to rotate. Lock proportions keeps its shape.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo para xictlapehpeni ce canahya. Xictotoxo iihtic para xicihcueni, pan ce machiotl cuadrado tlen esquina zo itenno para xicpatla ihuexca, zo pan nopa machiotl yahualtic para xicyahualo. Xiccahua san se relación entre ipatlauhca huan ihuahcapanyo para axmopatla quen neci.

entries.source: Drag across the ellipse's bounding box.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo hasta ceyoc esquina tlen nopa rectángulo tlen quiyahualoa elipse.

entries.source: Drag between opposite corners. Choose outline or fill below.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo desde ce esquina hasta nopa esquina tlen mocahua iixpan. Tlatzintla xictlapehpeni zan itenno zo nochi iihtic.

entries.source: Drag between opposite corners to draw a five-pointed star. Choose an outline or fill.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo desde ce esquina hasta nopa esquina tlen mocahua iixpan para xicchihua ce citlalin ica macuilli itzoncua. Xictlapehpeni zan itenno zo nochi iihtic.

entries.source: Drag between opposite corners to draw a heart. Choose an outline or fill.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo desde ce esquina hasta nopa esquina tlen mocahua iixpan para xicchihua ce yollotl. Xictlapehpeni zan itenno zo nochi iihtic.

entries.source: Drag from the start to the end of the line.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo campa pehua hasta campa tlami nopa tlahuazantli.

entries.source: Drag from the tail towards the arrowhead. Choose an outline or fill.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo desde icuitlapil nopa mitl hasta itzoncua. Xictlapehpeni zan itenno zo nochi iihtic.

entries.source: Drag out to expand, in to trim. Drag inside to move the bounds. Pinch or Fit for more space. BG fills new space.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo quiyahuac para ma eli achi huei, iihtic para xictequi. Xictotoxo iihtic para xicihcueni inepamitl. Ica ome momahpil zo ica “Ma nochi neci” hueli tiquitta ocachi huei canahya. Ixnezcayotl iica quitemitia nopa yancuic canahya.

entries.source: Drag placed images to move them. Hold and drag a thumbnail to add it.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo ixcopincayotl tlen ya eltoc para xicihcueni. Xiccahua momahpil ce tlatoctzin pan ce pilixcopincayotl huan xictotoxo para tictlaliz.

entries.source: Drag to pan without drawing. Pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Two-finger navigation also works with drawing tools.
entries.wording: Xictotoxo para xicpatla campa tiquitta huan axxitlapa. Xicnechco zo xiciyocatlali ome momahpil para ma neci achi cuecuetztzin zo achi huei, huan xictotoxo ome momahpil para xicpatla campa tiquitta. Ni nouhquiya hueli ticchihua quemman tictequihuia tlamantli para titlapaz.

entries.source: Draw a crisp line. Adjust Width from 1 to 100 pixels.
entries.wording: Xicchihua ce tlahuazantli tlen neci melahuac. Xicpatla ipatlauhca: 1 hasta 100 pixels.

entries.source: Draw around an area. Drag inside to move, square corner or edge handles to resize, or the round handle to rotate. Commit selection applies the edit.
entries.wording: Xicchihua inepamitl ce canahya. Xictotoxo iihtic para xicihcueni, pan ce machiotl cuadrado tlen esquina zo itenno para xicpatla ihuexca, zo pan nopa machiotl yahualtic para xicyahualo. Ica “Xictlali tlen tictlapehpenqui pan ixcopincayotl” mocahua tlen ticchiuhqui.

entries.source: Draw soft watercolor strokes. Strength controls how strongly the colour blends into the canvas.
entries.wording: Xicchihua tlahuazantli tlen axchicahuac, quen ica ixnezcayotl huan atl. Xicpatla ichicahualis para xictlanahuati quen moaneloa ixnezcayotl campa titlapa.

entries.wording: Xicpa ica pincel, ica itzoncua huan ihuexca tlen tictlapehpenqui.
